name: OpenOS 1.6.1
description: Larger script limits for the redesigned Settings: 384 string constants, 320 names and 192 numeric constants per script (were 224/224/96), with the bytecode cache format updated to match; cache entries from an older firmware are rebuilt quietly instead of failing the script. Adds fs.usage(path) for measuring folders (the Storage page uses it) and sys.info("reserve"). Update Settings from OpenStore after installing.
